scripts.vercel:guard-project: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.vercel/project.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Refusing deploy: .vercel/project.json is missing. Run: npx vercel link --scope 1019-gallery --project gallery-1019-site');process.exit(1);}const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));if(j.projectName!=='gallery-1019-site'){console.error('Refusing deploy: linked project is '+(j.projectName||'UNKNOWN')+'. Expected gallery-1019-site.');process.exit(1);}if(j.orgId!=='team_pLAV9RSL1pTmVUlpjZITNGc9'){console.error('Refusing deploy: linked orgId is '+(j.orgId||'UNKNOWN')+'. Expected team_pLAV9RSL1pTmVUlpjZITNGc9.');process.exit(1);}"
scripts.deploy:prod:safe: npm run vercel:guard-project && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.deploy:prod:quick:main: npm run vercel:guard-project && npm run deploy:prod:main
